newObjects.description: List of new {@link TimedIntervalValue} objects from loading data set.

existingObjects.description: Stream of existing {@link TimedIntervalValue} relation objects of the same type that have not yet ended.

endExistingRelations.description: If set true, ends all the existing relations and upserts only relations loaded from the template.

isTreeStructure.description: Whether the relation structure is a tree structure.
